༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum tha)pa'i dkar chag/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum tha)pa'i dkar chag /

ka dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi them byang pad+ma'i phreng ba/1 kha dgongs pa yang zab kyi smin grol sbyin pa'i tho yig / ga dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las/ zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga don gnyis myur 'grub/ nga zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi dkyil chog don gnyis myur 'grub zhi khro'i dbang phreng la sbyor tshe bum bskyed kha bsgyur/ ca dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las/ zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga don gnyis myur 'grub kyi kha sgyur lhan thabs dgos 'dod myur 'grub/ cha dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las/ rgyal ba zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi skong bshags na raka dong sprug gi cho ga tshogs gnyis myur 'grub/ ja dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi las byang rtsa ba gsum gyi bskang ba bshags zlog bsam don myur 'grub/ nya bstan srung gsum la rtags dang don gyi sgo nas rdzogs pa chen po gnyis med a ti yo ga ltar bstod pa tshangs dbyangs lha'i rnga chen/ ta 'chi med tshe'i skor gyi dbang gnad zab tshe'i dbang bskur gyi las byang dbang dang bcas pa/ tha bla ma tshe dbang 'dzin pa'i las byang*/ da dam chos dgongs pa yab zab las: tshe'i dbang po 'dzin pa'i bla ma gsang ba'i sgrub thabs kyi las gzhung*/ na dam chos dgongs pa yang zab zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga dge legs myur 'grub/ pa dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi rtsa ba gsum gyi las byang gi kha skong phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg bsdus pa/ pha dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las/ zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg phrin las myur 'grub/ ba dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las/ zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi sāts+tsha'i cho ga phan bde myur 'grub/ ma rtsa gsum rnal 'byor bsdus/ tsa gtum mo ye shes rab 'bar gyi 'khrul 'khor/ tsha sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi spyi dang bye brag bde gshegs 'dus pa'i chos kyi byung tshul 'khrul med yid ches drug ldan/

dza bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang sgrub kyi lag len dmar khrid brjed byang*/ wa sgrub chen bka' brgyad nyang lugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi tshon yig lha mtshan shes ldan mkhas pa kun gyi dgongs rgyan/ zha bde gshegs 'dus pa sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi bskyed rdzogs 'bring po'i las byang mdor bsdus pa dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo/ za chos sman gyi dkar chag gsal ba'i me long*/ 'a gang shod du bsgrubs pa'i skye bdun dkar chag / ya bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sman sgrub gyi sngags byang zur du bkol ba/ ra bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i gtor zlog phrin las myur 'grub/ la sgrub pa bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga dngos grub kyi 'dod pa 'jo ba dbang gi rgyal po/ sha bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i 'cham yig brjed tho/ sa bla ma dgongs 'dus spyi dril gyi sgrub pa las bsdus pa nor bu'i snying po/ ha kun bzang dgongs pa kun 'dus kyi zhi khro'i las byang pad+ma'i phreng ba'i lhan thabs dus mtha'i cho ga thar pa'i lam ston/ a bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i rdzogs chen snying po shel gyi bum pa'i dngos gzhi nyams len rgyun 'khyer nyin mtshan rnal 'byor dus bzhi mnyam sbyor gyi gdams pa/
